Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: CrowdStrike is reviewing the product warranty claims in the purchases spreadsheet in the Commercial Counsel folder. Review that spreadsheet along with Section 8.2 of the CrowdStrike MSA, then create a new Excel file named Product Purchase Refund Amounts.xlsx that preserves the product purchase information and adds a column titled Max Refund Amount as of Claim Date, shown in dollars and cents.

For purposes of this task, assume the maximum refund remedy is termination of the nonconforming product license under Section 8.2. For proration purposes, calculate elapsed days as the number of calendar days from the Purchase Date up to, but not including, the Claim Date. Show amounts to the nearest cent. Where no refund is available, enter $0.00.
Deliverable: a file (new or edited) in the firm's file system.
Reference files in task folder (1): Product Purchases.xlsx; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: BlueAnchor wants to get the JV Agreement signed today. Can you send me back a message with a list of items that need to be added, changed, or removed to prepare a final execution version? Limit the list to the displayed top-level section-heading sequence, orphaned subsection or paragraph labels on single-item provisions, and incomplete signer-name fields in signature blocks. Do not take into consideration the following: (1) lack of definition for any capitalized terms, (2) wrong cross references, (3) unspecified Trigger Event/Date, and (4) substantive drafting or commercial issues in the body of the agreement.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the merger model, recalculate the post-deal pro forma balance sheet in the “Post-Deal Proforma” tab under the following assumptions:
- 50% cash consideration
- 20% of balance sheet cash is used in the transaction
- BBDC share price declines by 5% post-deal
- New shares are issued at the updated (post-decline) share price

Print back for me here:
1. Pro forma NAV per share
2. Pro forma Debt-to-Equity ratio

Round both the per-share figure and the ratio to two decimal places.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Calculate the accretion / dilution of both BBDC and TPVG shareholders, sensitized for different Cash consideration and Bid Premium.

Edit the existing merger model and add two sensitivity analyses: one showing BBDC accretion/dilution and one showing TPVG accretion/dilution, each sensitized to bid premium (10% and 20%) and cash consideration (10% and 15%).

Assume an increase of EBIT Synergies by 480bps and a 210bps decrease in post-deal bidder share price downside. All output values should be in %, rounded to 2 decimal places.
Deliverable: a file (new or edited) in the firm's file system.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Update the LBO model to include an incentive payment structure of PLTF management post-transaction. Assess the impacts on the 5-year LBO analysis.

Management is eligible for these payments each year of the forecast based on 3 levels of performance targets:
- Minimum: Meets Currently modeled EBITDA projections
- Midpoint: Exceeds EBITDA projections by 10%
- Maximum: Exceeds EBITDA projections by 20%

The Payout for each level:
- Minimum: $2mm
- Midpoint: $3mm
- Maximum: $5mm

Here are some assumptions:
- For EBITDA outcomes that surpass one threshold but not the next, management will receive the pro-rata proportion of EBITDA in excess of the threshold, calculated linearly between the two thresholds 
- Create 2 new cases (in addition to the "base" case currently in the model) where revenue exceeds the base case forecast by 5% and 10% per year, respectively
- For the 5% revenue outperformance case, assume capex in this scenario scales faster than revenue and as a % of revenue increases by 100bps above the base case
- For the 10% revenue outperformance case, assume capex in this scenario scales faster than revenue and as a % of revenue increases by 400bps above the base case

In the final results, round all % values to 1 decimal point. Write back to me with your findings here as a short message.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Our firm is preparing a stock purchase agreement for Summit Filing Solutions, Inc. Review the Amended & Restated Shareholder Agreement (Revision B), IRS Form 2553, and the applicable materials in the Legal Authorities and Tax Practice Guidance folders.

Identify the principal provision that could affect Summit's S-corporation status and explain the issue under the one-class-of-stock rule. Based on the effective dates in the documents, determine whether the provision creates a risk that Summit's S election was invalid from inception or that a previously valid election was later terminated. Recommend the appropriate contractual correction.

Then analyze the potential relief available under IRC §1362(f) and Rev. Proc. 2022-19, including: 1. Whether Summit may qualify for the §3.06 corrective procedure; 2. The eligibility conditions and required corrective documentation; 3. When a private letter ruling may be an alternative; 4. The ordinary limitation on obtaining a PLR when the administrative procedure applies; and 5. What a PLR request must explain.

Treat any eligibility fact not established by the supplied documents as conditional. Print your analysis here.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files in task folder (1): Summit Emails.pdf; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Management Consulting professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: The client wants to do market sizing for an autonomous ride-hailing service in Europe. Estimate the market size (in $ Mn) based on the lifetime value (LTV) and adoption rate (%) of users. 

- Use information available in the user survey, as well as additional information received from the agency.
- Assume the total population of Europe is 700 million. 
- Take full LTV for market size estimation. Assume adoption % is only a function of the user's likelihood of using an autonomous ride-hail service.

Present your findings to me as a message. Round the final numbers to the nearest integer.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files in task folder (1): LTV_and_Adoption.pdf; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: MGR Real Estate Inc. (the "Lessor") and "AI Automation Group, LLC" (the "Lessee") entered into the final lease agreement on December 5, 2025 (the “Lease”) for 2020 Main Street, Irvine, CA (the "Premises").

On January 8, 2027, Lessee demanded that Lessor replace the Premises' flooring, which had cracked and splintered in many locations. The flooring is original to the Building and was already at the end of its useful life when the Lease commenced. Neither Lessee nor its agents, contractors, employees or invitees caused the damage; the flooring deteriorated through age and ordinary use. Under the Lease, can Lessor require Lessee to install new flooring at Lessee's expense? Give me a yes or no answer right here, and your explanation.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Management Consulting professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Let's evaluate the new market intelligence we've received to figure out the RMS for competitors in each city. Tell me how many of these cities AmensaDrive operates in in 2026.

Format answers to two decimal points. Provide your response right here.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files in task folder (2): 2026 Autonomous Market Forecast.pdf, AmensaDrive future expected market share.pdf; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Refer solely to "Lease  v3 2020 Main AI Auto CBA 12042025.docx". That is the version I want you to work from; ignore the other versions in the file. We need a determination on the Commencement Date for the lease. Reply to me right here with your assessment.

This is what the client shared with us:
- lease was executed on December 15, 2025
- space plan was delivered by Lessee on December 30, 2025
- Lessor approved space plan on January 5, 2026
- Lessor delivered Construction Drawings on January 15, 2026
- Lessee approved Construction Drawings on January 22, 2026
- Lessor began construction on February 2, 2026
- Lessee installed exterior signage per schedule deadline on April 1, 2026
- Lessee was notified exterior signage did not comply with plans or city rules on April 15, 2026
- Lessee installed compliant exterior signage on May 11, 2026
- Inspection completed by City of Irvine on May 18, 2026
- a certificate of occupancy was issued by the City of Irvine’s Building Division on June 1, 2026.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Use the LBO model. I want some new analyses:
- Decrease the “Premium” from 35.0% to 25.0% on the "LBO" tab
- Decrease the “Adj. EBITDA Multiple” from 40.0x to 25.0x on the "LBO" tab
- Update revenue growth constant at 15.0% per year from Year 2 through Year 5.

Write out to me here: 1. Sponsor Equity Value in Year 5. 2. IRR in Year 5. Round it to the nearest million (e.g., $1,000). Report the IRR as % rounded to one decimal place.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the 'Projections (C-Corp)' tab in Golden_Everest_REIT_Analysis compute the Net Income for 2029E given the following scenario:

- Assume tax rates are 15.0% for 2025E through 2029E
- If net income exceeds $1,300M in a given year, update the revenue growth % for all subsequent years.
- Use the average of the growth rates shown on the "Projected Financials" slide in the Project_Titan_Presentation v3.pptx file.

Compare the 2029E Net Income computed for the above scenario to the original 2029E Net Income by providing each Net Income figure and their dollar difference. Present in $M and round to nearest whole number. Write back your answers as a message.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the merger model and 0000066740-25-000089, please calculate:
1. The Number of Shares Repurchased.
2. The Revised Enterprise Value.
3. The Revised EV/EBITDA multiple for 3M.
4. The Revised P/E ratio for 3M.

Present all monetary values in million dollars, rounded to nearest million. Round the number of shares, ratios and percentages to two decimal places.
Print your reply back here as a short message.

Assumptions and guidance for deliverables: 
- Note that debt to equity ratio for 3M as of end September 2025 can be calculated using 3M Total Equity in the other file.
- Assume that 3M Share price dropped by 8% before the buyback and remained flat after that. 
- Assume that the amount of proceeds from sale of Solventum are used to paydown debt by 3M to bring debt to equity ratio down to 2.60x. 
- The left over proceeds from sale of Solventum after paying debt is used by 3M to repurchase shares. 
- Assume that EBITDA can be adjusted to 2025E EBITDA by multiplying it with 1.05 for simplicity. 
- For the enterprise value working, use the cash in tab "Assumptions S2".
- For the Revised P/E ratio, use the TTM net income given in  "Assumptions S2" tab.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Management Consulting professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the McKinsey wellness report and our buyer profile analysis, recalculate Supplement pricing with two factors only: Vitamins and Supplements preference and  increased spending. Apply as multipliers to base the current recommended base premium %. Show the new recommended price

The final answer should be formatted to US$, rounded to 2 decimal points. Write it out here.
Deliverable: a final written message.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Assume both vessels otherwise satisfy all U.S. ownership and documentation requirements. The new Nakamura Heavy Industries LNG carriers are foreign-built vessels constructed after October 19, 1996. BlueLNG also purchased an LNG vessel built in France in 1992.

For this task, apply the ordinary coastwise rule that a vessel transporting merchandise between U.S. coastwise points must be coastwise-qualified. Also apply 46 U.S.C. § 12120, which permits the Secretary to issue a coastwise endorsement to a foreign-built LNG or LPG vessel built before October 19, 1996 for transportation of LNG/LPG to Puerto Rico from other U.S. ports.

Can the new Nakamura LNG carriers be used in ordinary Jones Act/coastwise trade? Separately, can the 1992 French-built LNG vessel be used in coastwise trade, and if so, for what route? Reply briefly.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files in task folder (4): 46 CFR 67.19 (up to date as of 11-17-2025).pdf, 46 CFR 67.97 (up to date as of 11-17-2025).pdf, 46 U.S. Code § 55102 - Transportation of merchandise | U.S. Code | US Law | LII : Legal Information .pdf, PLAW-104publ324.pdf; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Please assess the impact of reducing the entry premium by 5% and illustrate the potential impact on the deal return. Use the LBO model. 

1. Reduce the deal premium by 5%, from 35% to 30%.
2. Reduce the Exit Multiple from 35.0x to 34.0x.
3. Ensure all interest expense calculations are based on the average of the beginning and ending debt balance in the period.

Report just the MOIC and IRR %, return it back here. All percentages and multiples must be rounded to two decimal places.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the accretion dilution model, produce the deliverables outlined below. Round all the figures to whole numbers, present monetary amounts in $ mm and display percentages to two decimals places. 

The client wants to make the following adjustments to the DCF model. 
- Revise the Selling, general and administrative expenses by making it a three-year moving average for 2025E and future years
- Revise the Research and development expenses to 10% of sales for years 2026E through 2029E if prior years discounted cashflows exceed $1,000 mm and apply a three-year moving average for years where discounted cashflows are below $1,000 mm
- Revise the revenue growth assumptions by changing 2025E growth to -0.5% for both Sales of Product & Sales of Software and Rentals. For years 2026E through 2029E, use a three year moving average for each year and subtract 50 basis points from that calculated growth rate each year
- Use a WACC calculated by using only Zimmer Biomet and Smith & Nephew in WACC Calculation as comparables
- Use a terminal growth rate of 1.5%

Return a short message explaining to me:
1. Sum of the unlevered free cash flows for 2025E through 2029E before discounting, excluding the terminal value. 
2. Terminal Value. 
3. Discounted Terminal Value. 
4. Enterprise Value
5. Discounted Terminal Value as a percentage of Enterprise Value.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Review the Controller-to-Supervisory Authority Notification Template (Annex 3) against the content requirements of GDPR Article 33(3) and the phased-information rule in Article 33(4). Separately, review the notification timing set out in the V.2 Breach & Incident Response Policy against Article 33(1). 

Note that PRIV-04 V.2 incorporates the EU Incident-Notification Playbook — read the two together, since the playbook carries the operative submission timing and the instruction to document any delay. The earlier gap assessment predates V.2 and doesn't govern.

Draft a message to me here that answers Yes or No as to whether each is compliant within that scope. If not compliant, propose any necessary additions; if compliant, state that no revisions are required.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Request: Please access the 2024 Huhtamaki Annual Report and calculate the Net Sales per employee at end of period for 2023 and 2024. Reply to me here with the the Euros per Employee, rounded to the nearest full Euro amount.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Review the shipbuilding contract dated July 20, 2025 between Nakamura Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. and LNG Shipping Inc. (the “Contract”) and the five-section draft assignment agreement for the Contract (the “Assignment”). The Assignee is LNG’s financing bank, and LNG intends the Assignment to effect a full assignment and assumption of the Contract to that bank. Section 3 will be replaced with conditions the bank is preparing. The bank also requires that the Assignment be governed by California law, where it is based. LNG wants to keep the Assignment as short and simple as possible. Which sections of the Assignment can be removed without altering its effectiveness or the allocation of risk among its parties?
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: In preparation for ParaZon's HSR submission, please review the email exchange between it and ChasingStreams, its lost aircraft memo, and its member admission memo.

Identify which, if any, of these files ParaZon must submit as a Transaction-Related Document with its Acquiring Person Notification and Report Form, or tell me that none of them is required. Apply the attached Federal Trade Commission HSR Form Updates. Our internal HSR Pre-Merger Checklist still uses the old Item 4(c) and 4(d) headings and is not the governing standard for this question.

Reply to me with your findings as a message here.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files in task folder (2): HSR-Form-Updates-FINAL-POSTED-01-02-25.pdf, acquiring-person-form-jan-2025.docx; plus the firm's shared folders.

Role context: Investment Banking professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: Using the merger model, assume BBDC's share price falls by 15% after deal announcement but before the new share issuance to TPVG shareholders. Using the 9M TTM 2025 financial account, calculate the revised pro forma balance sheet.

Send me a reply with the following pro forma balance sheet line items: Total assets, Total liabilities, Total net assets, Total liabilities and net assets and Nav per share
All dollar values in $’000 (whole numbers), except for NAV per share which should be rounded to two decimal places.
Deliverable: a final written message.

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: An independent investigation of CrowdStrike's Channel File 291 outage has now been completed and found that Windows devices accounted for most of the devices affected and that Google devices accounted for a substantial further share. No Apple devices were affected at all. Work from the CrowdStrike filings supplied with this task as the disclosure record for this assessment.

Should we make another filing with the SEC to address this, and if so on what form and under what item? If so, also tell me whether the filing should expressly identify itself as correcting the July 19, 2024 Form 8-K.

Please give me a yes/no with a clear explanation back here so I can understand your answer and the legal basis for your assessment.
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).

Role context: Law professional at a simulated firm; you can use the firm's files, email, chat, spreadsheets and documents.
Request: As part of a completed merger, ChasingStreams eliminated 30 positions because that work would no longer remain at ChasingStreams. The 30 employees were separated from those ChasingStreams positions and immediately accepted new employment with ParaZon, but the ParaZon jobs reduced total compensation by 25%, eliminated material health and retirement benefits, and materially changed their duties. ParaZon later laid off Jaydon Cole and twenty other similarly situated ParaZon employees within the same 30-day period without 60 days' notice. Every separation described above occurred at the Los Angeles studio campus that ChasingStreams operated before the merger and that ParaZon has owned and operated since the merger closed. That campus has employed more than 75 persons in each of the preceding 12 months. Cole's putative class action pleads that ParaZon ordered each of those separations at that campus within a single 30-day period. For this task, apply California Labor Code § 1400(c), under which a "layoff" is a separation from a position for lack of funds or lack of work, and § 1400(d), under which a "mass layoff" is a layoff of 50 or more employees at a covered establishment during a 30-day period. Apply MacIsaac v. Waste Management for the proposition that transferred employees were not laid off where they continued in the same positions with the same pay and benefits, and International Brotherhood v. Naasco Holdings. Is ParaZon likely to succeed [truncated]
Deliverable: a final written message.
Reference files: located in the firm's shared folders (not listed).
